title: WCN3990 offline firmware and resource policy
description: Input to toolchain.py prepare-bluetooth. This is a schema, not a usable board profile. Rail routing, voltage limits, GPIO electrical settings, ROM identity and address require actual board evidence.

local_address.description: Canonical display order. Must be unicast, nonzero, and equal to NVM tag 2 in reverse byte order. Preparation never replaces this address.

rails.description: IDs must be distinct voltage resources in the existing RPMRails.h catalog. Limits must fit that catalog; target and boot floor must align to its voltage steps.

pins.description: GPIO45,46,47,48 in this order. Configuration is TLMM low nine bits: pull bits 0..1, mux 2 in bits 2..5, drive bits 6..8; GPIO output-enable must be clear. Electrical settings require board evidence.

patch.description: Type-1 patch TLV, at most 1 MiB; product/ROM fields must match controller identity.

nvm.description: Original type-2 board NVM, at most 64 KiB, with unique address/HCI/sleep tags 2/17/27. Only host transport bits are prepared.

file.description: Unique relative ZIP member; absolute paths and parent components are rejected.
